Architecture: Express API (`backend/index.js`): routes `backend/src/routes/`, controllers `backend/src/controllers/`, repositories `backend/src/repositories/`; `RepositoryFactory` switches JSON/Mongo. Menu uploads use multer `upload.single("image")`. React app: `frontend/src/`; admin UI `frontend/src/pages/admin/` (example `adminhomes.jsx`). API client `frontend/src/lib/api.js` uses fetch, `credentials: 'include'`, detects FormData and unwraps response formats. Image storage uses local filesystem or Cloudinary, configured in `backend/.env` (`IMAGE_STORAGE_TYPE`, `CLOUDINARY_*`). JWT auth uses httpOnly cookies; frontend API sends `credentials: 'include'`.

Read first: `backend/src/routes/*.js`, `backend/src/controllers/*`, `backend/src/repositories/repository.factory.js`, `backend/.env.examples`, `frontend/src/lib/api.js`, `frontend/src/pages/admin/adminhomes.jsx`. Routes show middleware/controllers and `upload.single("image")`; controllers call repositories. `.env.examples` lists required vars.

Cookie-first auth: never rely on localStorage tokens in production — code includes a development fallback but expects httpOnly cookies.

File uploads: backend expects multipart/form-data for routes with multer; the frontend must not set `Content-Type` header explicitly when sending FormData (the client `api.js` handles this). Setting `Content-Type` manually will break boundary generation.

Tests: `backend/src/__tests__` uses `supertest`, app export from `backend/index.js`, and sometimes repository factories for fixtures.

When running backend npm tests locally always comment out the `MONGO_URI` environment variable in the `.env` file at the `./backend` folder make sure it was not declared and just un-comment it back after testing, Also skip cloudinary test cases if at least one of the following environment variables is not set, is empty or is not present in the `.env` file: `IMAGE_STORAGE_TYPE`, `CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME`, `CLOUDINARY_API_KEY` and `CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET`.

Scripts: inspect root `package.json`, `backend/package.json`, and `frontend/package.json` for exact commands. Backend dev: `cd backend && npm run dev`. Frontend dev: `cd frontend && npm start`. Tests: `cd backend && npm test`. CI workflows: `.github/workflows/backend-ci.yml`, `.github/workflows/frontend-ci.yml`.

Use repository factory for controller/test data operations; check `IMAGE_STORAGE_TYPE` and Cloudinary config before changing storage. For uploads, check `frontend/src/lib/api.js` and remove manual `Content-Type` for FormD
